ownRead.title: Engineered domains
ownRead.description: An open claim retained by the selected v0.2.1 companion.
ownRead.statement: **O6 — Engineered domains.** Speculative “magic” means advanced control of effective physical behavior through organization and mode structure, not a claim of demonstrated supernatural effects. Controllable effective dynamics are real in selected settings (E15); a self-propagating domain with an arbitrarily selected rule set is an open extrapolation.
ownRead.scope: Source-reported open claim, not a demonstrated result or a required proof before publication.
ownRead.body:
## Investigate one part

Identify the effective interaction or response to be engineered and the apparatus conditions that supply it. The selected Hofstadter example concerns a particular laser-assisted tunnelling setting, rather than arbitrary replacement of fundamental laws. A useful contribution would connect a proposed controllable setting to its intended observable effect and limits.

Bring a source passage, model, result or objection to [the contribution route](/about/#contribute). You can address this question without accepting the entire proposal. Read [all open questions](/open-problems/) for the surrounding programme.
